definitions.explanation: Property or assets pledged as security for a loan, especially real estate used to secure a home loan.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}を{抵当|ていとう}に{入|い}れてお{金|かね}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed money using my house as collateral.

examples.japanese: {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん}を{設定|せってい}する。
examples.english: To set up a mortgage lien.
examples.notes: {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん} = mortgage right/lien

examples.japanese: {ローン}{完済|かんさい}で{抵当|ていとう}{権|けん}が{抹消|まっしょう}された。
examples.english: The mortgage was released when the loan was paid off.

examples.japanese: この{土地|とち}は{抵当|ていとう}に{入|はい}っている。

notes:
LEGAL/FINANCIAL TERM:
{抵当|ていとう} is a formal legal term for collateral, most commonly used in real estate mortgages.

KEY COMPOUNDS:
- {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん}: Mortgage right, lien
- {抵当|ていとう}{物|ぶつ}: Collateral, mortgaged property
- {抵当|ていとう}{流|なが}れ: Foreclosure

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {抵当|ていとう}に{入|い}れる: to put up as collateral
- {抵当|ていとう}に{入|はい}っている: to be mortgaged
- {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん}を{設定|せってい}する: to establish a mortgage lien
- {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん}を{抹消|まっしょう}する: to release a mortgage

TYPES IN JAPANESE LAW:
- {抵当|ていとう}: General mortgage (doesn't require possession transfer)
- {質|しち}: Pledge (requires possession transfer)

RELATED TERMS:
- {担保|たんぽ}: Security, collateral (more general term)
- {住宅|じゅうたく}ローン: Home loan, mortgage
- {不動産|ふどうさん}: Real estate
- {債権|さいけん}: Credit, claim

NOTE: When buying property in Japan, understanding {抵当|ていとう}{権|けん} is essential as it appears on property registration ({登記簿|とうきぼ}).
